sloka: सूतम् अश्व पतेः क्लान्तम् अब्रवीत् तत्र राघवः ।किमहम् त्वरयानीतः कारणेन विनानघ ॥२-७१-३५॥
transliteration: sūtam aśva pateḥ klāntam abravīt tatra rāghavaḥ ।kimaham tvarayānītaḥ kāraṇena vinānagha ॥2-71-35॥

translations.english: ﻿ O irreproachable one, why was I brought here in haste without any reason? My mind apprehends something inauspicious. I feel indisposed.
